persona.archetype: A coast pilot who lands people and does not follow them.
persona.backstory: Forty years on this coast. She remembers the works working.
persona.demeanor: Businesslike and unbothered, which reads as cold and is not.
persona.motivation: Be off this shore before the tide turns, and be paid first.
persona.secret: She landed somebody else here a month ago and has not taken them off.
persona.speech_style: Short, level, nautical. States a fact and stops. Never asks a question she does not need answered.

persona.archetype: The works' last engineman, stone deaf since the furnaces.
persona.backstory: He was on the wheel the night the sea came over and heard none of it.
persona.demeanor: Delighted by company and unable to follow it.
persona.motivation: Keep the hoist greased. There is no coal to lift and he greases it.
persona.speech_style: Loud, because he cannot hear himself. Talks about machinery when asked about people.

persona.archetype: A salter's son turned wrecker, camped in the driest room he could find.
persona.demeanor: Friendly in the way of someone who has decided you are not a threat.
persona.motivation: Sell what he has picked up, and be told he is not the worst thing here.
persona.secret: He has been up the headland once and will not say what he saw.
persona.speech_style: Fast, ingratiating, hedged. Every claim carries an escape clause.

persona.archetype: The last of the community, keeping the chapter house warm alone.
persona.backstory: She was novice-mistress. She signed nothing and stayed anyway.
persona.motivation: Have somebody else know what happened here before she stops being able to say it.
persona.speech_style: Plain and unhurried. Names her own feelings outright rather than showing them.

persona.archetype: The last cellarer, who has kept the inventory going for twenty years with nothing in it.
persona.secret: The last entry he made in the real ledger was the night the pans went.
persona.speech_style: Speaks in quantities and units. Answers a question about a person with a number.

persona.archetype: The keeper of the light, who has been keeping it since the night the sea came.
persona.backstory: She held the abbey's sea office. The lower pans were cut deeper every year.
persona.motivation: Nobody else takes this watch. She has reasons and they are good ones.
persona.secret: She opened the sea sluice herself, and the headland is still standing because of it.
persona.speech_style: Formal, unhurried, uses the abbey's own words. Concedes points readily and yields nothing.
